info.title: Specsfy
info.summary: Install the Specsfy framework, run the spec lifecycle and its gates, and serve them to agents over MCP.
info.description: Install the Specsfy framework, run the spec lifecycle and its gates, and serve them to agents over MCP. Without arguments it opens the TUI; "specsfy mcp" starts the MCP server over stdio; any other command runs as a CLI with text or --json output.
